subject.title: fix(exec-approval): distinguish non-persistable command from ask=always policy in approval prompt

question: Should maintainers continue repairing this focused PR as the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/97069, or route the work to a broader sibling branch once it is ready?
rationale: Multiple open PRs target the same approval-copy bug, and this branch still has a native Telegram coverage gap plus a contributor real-proof gate.

options.title: Repair this PR before merge
options.body: Keep this PR open, carry the reason through native Telegram approval payloads, require real prompt proof, and use it as the landing path if maintainers prefer the focused diff.

options.title: Promote a broader sibling
options.body: If a broader sibling becomes clean and maintainer-preferred, preserve this PR's useful context there and close this branch only after that canonical path is viable.

recommendation.title: Repair this PR before merge
